selected_evidence.requirement: Local package repository built from local storage and served
selected_evidence.summary: hello .deb downloaded to /srv/local-repo/pool, dpkg-scanpackages generated Packages/Packages.gz, and python3 http.server confirmed listening on $NODE_IP:8080 serving the Packages file

selected_evidence.requirement: Remote repositories made genuinely unreachable (network-level, not just config)
selected_evidence.summary: iptables/ip6tables REJECT rules added for all resolved archive.ubuntu.com/security.ubuntu.com addresses on ports 80/443; curl afterward failed to connect (exit 7) to both hosts

selected_evidence.requirement: apt configured to use only the local repo and successfully update against it
selected_evidence.summary: ubuntu.sources disabled, local-repo.list added pointing at http://$NODE_IP:8080, and apt-get update completed (exit 0) fetching Packages only from the local repo

selected_evidence.requirement: Package installed from the local repository while remotes were unreachable, and functions correctly
selected_evidence.summary: apt-get install -y hello fetched the package solely from http://10.100.2.10:8080, installed it, and running `hello` printed 'Hello, world!'

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline captured for node1

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restarted with safe reboot mechanism, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
